description: Team SAR Cosmos is building an interactive 3D dashboard for the Dancing with the SARs challenge. Nepal has 21 glacial lakes classed as critically dangerous, and only 2 have proper mitigation. We combine NISAR radar, which sees through monsoon clouds, with optical satellite history to track six of these lakes. The site shows published lake areas now and will add our own satellite results once the pipeline runs. Our risk tiers measure growth, not flood probability.
